verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show DeepSeek models being consumed through OpenRouter, an OpenRouter-class router, so access is not limited to the vendor's own endpoint. Nothing in the pack covers Bedrock, Vertex or Azure, and no first-party docs list third-party distribution channels. missing for 10: Bedrock availability, Vertex availability, Azure availability, first-party documentation of cloud/gateway distribution.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint
